description: In every model \(M\models Q\), an element \(a\) satisfies \(a\le\overline n\), interpreted as \(\exists z\,(z+a=\overline n)\), exactly when \(a=\overline m\) for some external natural number \(m\le n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.finite_bound.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.Q] (a : M) (n : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M a
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M n) ↔
    ∃ m ≤ n, a = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M m
